stances.quote:
I've never seen so many people defending murderers as I have in the past year or so.

So much sympathy for killers and so little for their victims.

Some people's morality is completely inverted.

stances.summary: Criticizes lenient treatment in violent crime cases
stances.quote:
All of these 'complex' cases of people shooting, stabbing, and strangling others to death. 😑

Oops.

stances.summary: Cites insanity acquittal case, argues justice system needs reform
stances.quote:
A few years ago, there was a woman who drowned her baby, and stabbed her husband and teenage daughter.

She was acquitted on grounds of 'insanity' induced by COVID.

I'm not joking... Look it up.

The justice system does need reform. Just not how most people think.

stances.summary: Argues women receive disproportionate sympathy in violent crime cases
stances.quote:
It's only framed as 'complex' because a woman did it.

No man would ever get such a level of sympathy, empathy, and 'understanding' for killing multiple children. No matter his hormones, 'mental health', or whatever drugs he took.

Come off it.

And this isn't the only case.

stances.summary: Criticizes shifting cultural standards labeling normal people as extremists
stances.quote: Being a normal person from 2006 makes you a 'right wing extremist' now.

stances.summary: Attacks progressivism as destructive death cult disguised as benevolent
stances.quote:
Beneath its veneer of kindness, empathy, and intellectualism, 'progressivism' is essentially a death cult.

It cuts down entire populations and snuffs out civilisations. But it does so with a smile.

stances.summary: Critiques political obsession as distraction from personal accountability
stances.quote:
Politics matters. Culture matters. Society matters.

At the same time, people obsess over external things to distract from their personal responsibilities. It's a way of outsourcing accountability to third parties.

If you can't fix your life, you certainly can't fix the world.

stances.summary: Film balanced, rejects both 'woke' and anti-woke extremes
stances.quote:
I watched 'The Odyssey' in the cinema this morning. 9am IMAX showing, like a weirdo.

It was alright... Not incredibly amazing as some people are saying and not terrible or annoyingly 'woke' as others have suggested.

Great cinematography with some standout scenes, but some weird

stances.summary: Predicts increased human value as AI content proliferates online
stances.quote: All the AI slop and general fakery online makes me more bullish on the future of real world human interaction and in person events. I believe people will start to value it more.

stances.summary: Criticizes American food price inflation as excessive
stances.quote:
I am currently in the Middle East, and I can confirm that shawarma prices have risen from 50 cents in my childhood to $2 today... 

Seriously though, American food prices have gotten insane. Every time I'm there I get sticker shock.

stances.summary: Criticizes monetary policy as cause of affordability crisis
stances.quote: Concerning affordability, has anybody considered stopping the nonstop printing of infinite 'money'?

stances.summary: Opposes taxes, advocates for abolition of all taxation
stances.quote:
It's wild seeing people advocating for more and more taxes. A tax on every asset and action, even those that are already taxed.

Meanwhile, I think they should all be abolished...

Say what you want, but I'm grateful to live in a place where my view is the popular one.

stances.summary: Inflation remains serious based on supplement price increases

And it's serious out there.

stances.summary: Dismisses accusations of hateful rhetoric as outdated
stances.quote:
'Hateful rhetoric'. 😂 

It's been a while since I've been accused of that. Feels like Twitter circa 2018.

stances.summary: Prefers X over other social media platforms
stances.quote:
X is the only social media platform that I actually like.

The others have some business benefits but I don't actually enjoy spending time on them.

stances.summary: Rejects wealth inequality as a major problem
stances.quote:
I've never been convinced that 'wealth inequality' is a big problem.

I have 10,000x more money than some people, and some have 10,000x more than me. It's irrelevant. Human worth isn't financial.

Envy, greed, and poverty itself are problems. The solution for poverty isn't theft.

stances.summary: Argues critics of wealth inequality mask personal envy as compassion
stances.quote:
Further, there are many people who mask their envy of the rich as love for the poor.

It's why they say 'eat the rich' instead of 'feed the poor'.

Amusingly, such people are usually very well off by global standards... They don't hate 'rich people' but those richer than them.

stances.quote:

This is democracy and decentralisation in action. The people of NYC will get what they voted for.

stances.summary: Criticizes ongoing debate about sex and gender definitions

stances.summary: Criticizes illegal immigration benefits versus legal immigrant costs
stances.quote:
Legally migrating to North America or Western Europe can easily cost 5 to 6 figures if you're a law-abiding, productive entrepreneur. And you don't get any free stuff.

Or... you can just show up on a boat or run over a land border, and get more free stuff than citizens do.
